<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Update post titles to include their actual IDs
$posts = get_posts(array(
	'post_type' => 'post',
	'posts_per_page' => -1,
	'post_status' => 'publish',
	'orderby' => 'ID',
	'order' => 'ASC'
));

foreach ($posts as $post) {
	if (strpos($post->post_title, 'will be updated') !== false) {
		wp_update_post(array(
			'ID' => $post->ID,
			'post_title' => 'Test Post - ID: ' . $post->ID
		));
	}
}

echo 'Cleaned and created ' . count($posts) . ' test posts';
?>

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$posts = get_posts(array('post_type' => 'post', 'posts_per_page' => -1, 'orderby' => 'date', 'order' => 'ASC'));
$flagged = 0;
foreach ($posts as $post) {
	// Unrelated noise meta on EVERY post. Without it, posts lacking the
	// sort key have no postmeta at all and an unkeyed EXISTS join cannot
	// mis-order them, hiding the bug this ordering test exists to catch.
	update_post_meta($post->ID, '_test_noise', '1758000000:' . $post->ID);
	if ($flagged >= 2) { continue; }
	update_post_meta($post->ID, '_test_featured', 'yes');
	$flagged++;
}
echo 'Flagged ' . $flagged . ' posts as featured; noise meta on ' . count($posts) . ' posts';
?>

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$one = wp_insert_term('Season One', 'category', array('slug' => 'season-one'));
$two = wp_insert_term('Season Two', 'category', array('slug' => 'season-two'));
$one_id = is_wp_error($one) ? 0 : $one['term_id'];
$two_id = is_wp_error($two) ? 0 : $two['term_id'];
$posts = get_posts(array('post_type' => 'post', 'posts_per_page' => -1, 'orderby' => 'date', 'order' => 'ASC'));
$index = 0;
foreach ($posts as $post) {
	$term_id = ($index < 5) ? $one_id : $two_id;
	wp_set_object_terms($post->ID, array($term_id), 'category');
	// Screening meta equal to the post ID: ascending meta order is
	// ascending-ID order, which differs from both date ASC and the
	// archive default of date DESC.
	update_post_meta($post->ID, '_test_screening', (string) $post->ID);
	$index++;
}
echo 'Categorized ' . $index . ' posts';
?>
